notes: VAT 10% applies only to the dealer's value added (direct method), not the gold value; imported unworked gold 0% (Andersen Vietnam Tax Booklet 2024). Bar import duty not found (SBV licence regime), null. Premium, buyback, used and making % removed in review round 1: they were calculated from a dealer price board reproduced only in news reports.

sources.name: Andersen in Vietnam - Vietnam Tax Booklet 2024
sources.what: Read 2026-11-27: VAT direct method for gold/silver/precious-stone traders: VAT = value added x 10%
